title: Flash flood
tldr: Move to higher ground immediately if a flash-flood warning affects you or water is rising. Never cross flowing water on foot or in a vehicle. Leave low areas, canyons and basements without waiting to see how high the water gets.
steps: Move away from streams, low roads and drainage channels.
Do not drive across a flooded road; the roadbed may be missing.
Call emergency services and move to a higher open level without becoming trapped in a closed attic.
Use current evacuation and road-closure instructions.
next: Wait for official clearance. Water may rise after rain stops or when storms occur upstream.
watch: A small-looking current can sweep away people and vehicles.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Move uphill before the route fills; leave belongings behind. If trapped above floodwater, remain in a safe elevated position and signal your location. Do not attempt to swim a current or enter water to rescue property.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
